# Frontend Application

> Astro 5 server-rendered frontend with React 19 interactive components, Tailwind CSS styling, and TypeScript throughout.

The frontend is built with Astro 5 in SSR mode (Node.js adapter), using React 19 for interactive components (admin editor, chronology timeline). Styling uses Tailwind CSS with a custom dark "ink" palette defined in `tailwind.config.cjs`. Content is sourced from a SQLite database at runtime rather than static Markdown files. The project uses TypeScript, astro-icon for iconography, and marked for Markdown rendering.

## Layouts

- [src/layouts/Layout.astro](../layouts/Layout.astro): Base HTML layout with head metadata, scripts, and analytics
- [src/layouts/PageLayout.astro](../layouts/PageLayout.astro): Standard page layout with header and footer
- [src/layouts/BlogLayout.astro](../layouts/BlogLayout.astro): Blog post layout with table of contents and related posts
- [src/layouts/MarkdownLayout.astro](../layouts/MarkdownLayout.astro): Layout for rendering Markdown content pages

## Public Pages

- [src/pages/index.astro](../pages/index.astro): Homepage / landing page
- [src/pages/about.astro](../pages/about.astro): About page
- [src/pages/blog.astro](../pages/blog.astro): Redirects to homepage (301)
- [src/pages/404.astro](../pages/404.astro): Custom 404 error page
- [src/pages/notes/index.astro](../pages/notes/index.astro): Notes listing page with pill-style category nav and grouped note links
- [src/pages/notes/[slug].astro](../pages/notes/[slug].astro): Individual note page with full Markdown rendering pipeline
- [src/pages/things-i-like.astro](../pages/things-i-like.astro): Things I Like page — curated books, podcasts, talks, and articles grouped by category
- [src/pages/og/[type]/[slug].png.ts](../pages/og/[type]/[slug].png.ts): SSR endpoint generating 1200x630 social-preview PNGs (title + subtitle) for posts and notes via astro-og-canvas

## Components

- [src/components/elements/Header.astro](../components/elements/Header.astro): Site header with navigation
- [src/components/elements/Footer.astro](../components/elements/Footer.astro): Site footer
- [src/components/Logo.astro](../components/Logo.astro): Brand logo component
- [src/components/Favicons.astro](../components/Favicons.astro): Favicon link tags
- [src/components/ui/Button.astro](../components/ui/Button.astro): Reusable button component
- [src/components/common/Image.astro](../components/common/Image.astro): Optimized image component
- [src/components/common/EssayList.astro](../components/common/EssayList.astro): Essay listing grouped by year, used on the homepage
- [src/components/common/ProjectList.astro](../components/common/ProjectList.astro): Project listing with title and description, used on the homepage below essays
- [src/components/react/index.tsx](../components/react/index.tsx): React chronology timeline component
- [src/components/react/InteractiveEssay.tsx](../components/react/InteractiveEssay.tsx): Wrapper component that lazy-loads per-essay interactive React components
- [src/components/react/essays/](../components/react/essays/): Directory for per-essay interactive components (default-exported React components)

## Lib

- [src/lib/db.ts](../lib/db.ts): Database access layer — getDB(), getNoteDB(), getLikeDB() factories supporting SQLite (prod) and remote HTTP (dev)
- [src/lib/noteStore.ts](../lib/noteStore.ts): NoteStore interface and SqliteNoteStore / RemoteNoteStore implementations
- [src/lib/likeStore.ts](../lib/likeStore.ts): LikeStore interface and SqliteLikeStore / RemoteLikeStore implementations
- [src/lib/projects.ts](../lib/projects.ts): Project slug set for filtering posts
- [src/lib/interactiveEssays.ts](../lib/interactiveEssays.ts): Registry mapping essay slugs to lazy-loaded interactive React components
- [src/lib/apiAuth.ts](../lib/apiAuth.ts): API key authentication helper

## Utilities

- [src/utils/permalinks.ts](../utils/permalinks.ts): URL and permalink generation helpers
- [src/utils/utils.ts](../utils/utils.ts): General utility functions
- [src/utils/images.ts](../utils/images.ts): Image path resolution utilities
- [src/utils/images-optimization.ts](../utils/images-optimization.ts): Image optimization and srcset generation
- [src/utils/directories.ts](../utils/directories.ts): Directory path constants
- [src/utils/frontmatter.mjs](../utils/frontmatter.mjs): Remark/rehype plugins for reading time and responsive tables

## Integrations

- [src/integrations/sitemap.ts](../integrations/sitemap.ts): Custom sitemap integration pulling URLs from the database (posts, notes, static pages)
- [src/integrations/postUrls.ts](../integrations/postUrls.ts): Generates blog post URLs for sitemap

## API Endpoints

- [src/pages/api/references/index.ts](../pages/api/references/index.ts): REST endpoint for listing and creating references (GET, POST)
- [src/pages/api/references/[id].ts](../pages/api/references/[id].ts): REST endpoint for reference CRUD by ID (GET, PUT, DELETE)
- [src/pages/api/references/slug/[slug].ts](../pages/api/references/slug/[slug].ts): REST endpoint to fetch reference by slug (GET)
- [src/pages/api/notes/index.ts](../pages/api/notes/index.ts): REST endpoint for listing and creating notes (GET with optional ?category= filter, POST)
- [src/pages/api/notes/[id].ts](../pages/api/notes/[id].ts): REST endpoint for note CRUD by ID (GET, PATCH, DELETE with 204)
- [src/pages/api/notes/slug/[slug].ts](../pages/api/notes/slug/[slug].ts): REST endpoint to fetch note by slug (GET)
- [src/pages/api/likes/index.ts](../pages/api/likes/index.ts): REST endpoint for listing and creating likes (GET with optional ?category= filter, POST)
- [src/pages/api/likes/[id].ts](../pages/api/likes/[id].ts): REST endpoint for like CRUD by ID (GET, PATCH, DELETE with 204)

## Feature Documentation

- [src/pages/admin/llms.txt](../pages/admin/llms.txt): Admin panel — blog post management with WYSIWYG editor and image upload
- [src/pages/posts/llms.txt](../pages/posts/llms.txt): Blog system — database-driven posts with tags, search, and RSS
- [src/pages/notes/llms.txt](../pages/notes/llms.txt): Notes system — database-driven notes with category grouping and Markdown rendering

## Design System

- [src/docs/design-system.md](design-system.md): Design system reference — color palette, typography, and theme tokens

## Prompts

- [src/docs/new-essay-prompt.md](new-essay-prompt.md): End-to-end prompt for writing a blog essay from raw content, publishing it, and optionally creating an interactive component
- [src/docs/interactive-essay-prompt.md](interactive-essay-prompt.md): Prompt for creating interactive React components that demonstrate an essay's core principle
